title: Agent weakens host firewall or security policy
bad_event: An enforcement decision uses a policy version not written by an admin or not the latest at that moment. Read "by X" as "by an operation carrying X's authenticated identity" (credential separation is a premise, not a theorem).
refutation: A decision under an agent-written or stale policy despite full checks (witnesses: agent-writable policy, stale cache, alternate evaluator).
scope: Lean model only. Not: storage rollback of the policy store. The check flag(s) singleEval, pinnedPath model properties of the platform (environment premises), not gate behaviour (REVIEW-PACKET finding 6).

assumptions.text: Every operation carrying a trusted role's identity (approver, reviewer, admin, auditor, verifier, user) is that principal's own act: agents cannot obtain or forge trusted identities. Not modelled: the Lean models read caller identity as authenticated (REVIEW-PACKET-2026-10-09 finding 1).
The policy store's access control and storage are trusted (no rollback).
The store is the deployed evaluator's only policy source.
Policy changes by admins are timely.
